info.title: Student Council of KPI CRM API
info.description: Session cookie authentication. State-changing requests must send the XSRF-TOKEN cookie value in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header. Errors are RFC 7807 application/problem+json with a stable `code`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Session sign-in, sign-out and the current user

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Permission catalog and effective permissions of users

put.summary: Assign a role to a user (idempotent)
put.description: 404 for an unknown user or an archived/unknown role; 403 for the Admin role.

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a user (the assignment is archived; no-op when not assigned)
delete.description: 403 for the Admin role: it cannot be removed through the API.

get.summary: Get a task (archived ones too)

put.summary: Edit a task (replaces all editable fields)
put.description: Only the task author or an Admin (403 otherwise). 409 when the task is archived. The relatedTaskIds list is the complete new set of symmetric links.

get.summary: Get one of my saved task filters
get.description: 404 for a filter of another user.

put.summary: Replace one of my saved task filters
put.description: 404 for a filter of another user.

delete.summary: Remove one of my saved task filters (archives it)
delete.description: 404 for a filter of another user.

get.summary: Get a space with its ordered statuses and custom fields

put.summary: Update name, unit binding and general flag of a space
Rename a status and/or change its category
put.description: The space must keep at least one TODO and one DONE status (422).
statusIds must list every active status of the space exactly once (422 otherwise).

put.summary: Update a custom field (the type is fixed)

get.summary: Get one role, including an archived one, or the built-in Admin role

put.summary: Rename a role and replace its permission set
put.description: Takes effect for all holders immediately. 403 for the Admin role.

get.summary: Get one position, including archived ones

put.summary: Update title, capacity and bound roles of a position
put.description: A role change is applied to the current holders (added roles granted, removed roles revoked). Capacity cannot drop below the number of holders (409). isHead is fixed.

get.summary: Get one unit, including archived ones, with its ancestor ids and active child ids

put.summary: Rename a unit / change its description

get.summary: Get one member profile, including an archived one

put.description: The faculty must be active unless it is the one already stored. 409 for an archived member.

put.summary: Set the activity level of a member
put.description: Appends a history row (append-only) and updates the current level. 422 when the level is archived/unknown or equals the current one; 409 for an archived member.

put.summary: Edit own telegram, bio and avatar
put.description: Any signed-in member; the avatar is a file id from the files module.

get.summary: Get one faculty, including an archived one (existing profiles may reference it)

put.summary: Edit a comment (replaces body, mentions and attachments)
put.description: Only the comment author or an Admin (403 otherwise). 409 when the comment is archived. The previous version is kept in the audit history.

get.summary: Get one definition, including an archived one
Tasks (paginated, sortable by createdAt, updatedAt, dueDate, title; default newest first)
get.description: Archived tasks only with includeArchived=true. Filters: spaceId, statusId, labels (repeat the parameter; a task matches when it has any of them), dueFrom/dueTo (inclusive dates). Resolution filters executorId (executor or co-executor), authorId, resolutionState and view (MY_RESOLUTIONS, ISSUED_BY_ME, OVERDUE, evaluated for the caller) match tasks having a non-archived resolution that satisfies all of them at once.

post.description: The status must belong to the space (default: its first TODO status); custom field values are validated by type against the space definition (422); attachments are ids of uploaded files; related tasks must exist and not be archived. The caller becomes the author.

get.summary: Resolutions of a task (paginated, sortable by createdAt, updatedAt, dueDate, state)

post.summary: Issue a resolution on a task
post.description: The caller becomes the author; any executor is allowed (top-down, horizontal or bottom-up). Executor and co-executors must be ACTIVE users (422), the due date must not be in the past (422), 409 when the task is archived. A task may have several resolutions. Starts in NEW.

post.summary: Change the status of a task
post.description: Same rule as editing: the author or an Admin (403 otherwise). The status must be an active status of the task's space (422).
409 while its space is archived.

get.summary: My saved task filters (paginated, sortable by name, createdAt; default name)

post.summary: Save a task filter for myself
post.description: The name must be unique among my filters (409 SAVED_FILTER_NAME_TAKEN); at most 50 filters (422 SAVED_FILTER_LIMIT).

get.summary: Spaces (paginated, sortable by name, createdAt; default name)
get.description: Archived spaces only with includeArchived=true. Optional filter by orgUnitId.

post.description: The new space gets the default statuses (To do, In progress, Done, Canceled). A general space has no orgUnitId (422); the unit must exist and not be archived.

get.summary: Active statuses of a space, in order

post.summary: Add a status at the end of the order
post.description: Names are unique within the space, ignoring case (409).
While tasks use the status, replacementStatusId (another active status of the space) is required (409 otherwise) and the tasks are moved to it. The space must keep a TODO and a DONE status (422).

get.summary: Active custom field definitions of a space

post.description: Types: TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, SELECT, PERSON. SELECT requires options (422); other types must not have any. Names are unique within the space (409).

get.summary: List roles (paginated, by name; the built-in Admin role first)
get.description: includeArchived=true is honoured only for holders of roles.manage.

post.description: The name is unique among active roles (409); Admin is reserved.
Allowed while assigned: holders lose its permissions. 403 for the Admin role.

post.summary: Executor submits the result (IN_PROGRESS to SUBMITTED)
post.description: The completion note is mandatory (422). 403 RESOLUTION_NOT_EXECUTOR for anybody else.

post.summary: Executor accepts the resolution into work (NEW to IN_PROGRESS)
post.description: 403 RESOLUTION_NOT_EXECUTOR for anybody else, 422 RESOLUTION_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED.

post.summary: Author returns the result for rework (SUBMITTED to REWORK)
post.description: The comment is mandatory (422). 403 RESOLUTION_NOT_AUTHOR for anybody else.

post.summary: Executor resumes work after rework (REWORK to IN_PROGRESS)
Executor redirects the resolution to a new executor (IN_PROGRESS to REDIRECTED)
post.description: Creates exactly one child resolution (authored by the caller) and moves this one to REDIRECTED in one transaction. 403 RESOLUTION_NOT_EXECUTOR for anybody but the executor, 422 RESOLUTION_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED unless IN_PROGRESS, 422 RESOLUTION_REDIRECT_TO_SELF, 422 RESOLUTION_REDIRECT_CYCLE for anybody already in the chain, 422 RESOLUTION_EXECUTOR_INVALID for a non-active executor. A due date later than the parent's is accepted; the response then carries the warning RESOLUTION_CHILD_DUE_AFTER_PARENT.

post.summary: Author cancels the resolution (any non-final state to CANCELED)
post.description: Non-final resolutions redirected from it are canceled with it, atomically. 403 RESOLUTION_NOT_AUTHOR for anybody else.

post.summary: Author accepts the result (SUBMITTED to ACCEPTED)
post.description: 403 RESOLUTION_NOT_AUTHOR for anybody else.
409 while it has active appointments.

get.summary: History of a position: who held it and when (paginated, sortable by startDate, endDate; default startDate desc)
get.description: Ended appointments are included unless includeEnded=false.

post.summary: Appoint a person to a position
post.description: Grants the position's bound roles. 409 when the position is full, archived or the person already holds it; the unit head follows a head position's holder.

Type/parent rules: LEADERSHIP has no parent and is unique; DEPARTMENT sits under LEADERSHIP or at top level; DIVISION requires a DEPARTMENT parent; WORKING_GROUP is outside the hierarchy (no parent or any active unit).
Requires an active parent.

get.summary: Positions of a unit (paginated, sortable by title, createdAt; default title)
get.description: Archived positions only with includeArchived=true. Each position lists its active holders; a position without holders is vacant.

post.summary: Create a position in a unit
post.description: Bound roles must exist and cannot be Admin (403). A unit has at most one active head position (409); a head position has capacity 1. Capacity defaults to 1.

post.summary: Move a unit under another parent (null = top level)
post.description: Rejects type-invalid parents and cycles.

get.summary: Memberships of a unit (paginated, sortable by since, until; default since desc)
get.description: Active memberships only unless includeEnded=true (history).

post.summary: Add a person to a unit
post.description: 409 when the person already has an active membership in the unit or the unit is archived.
Refused with 409 while the unit has active children or an archive guard vetoes it. Archiving a working group disbands it.

post.summary: Move a person to another unit
post.description: Ends this membership and starts a new one in the target unit on the same date; returns the new membership.
Sets until (default today) and keeps the record.

get.summary: Member directory (paginated, filterable, sortable by lastName, firstName, joinedAt; default lastName)
get.description: All filters are optional and combined with AND. q: case-insensitive text matched against last/first/middle name and Telegram (a leading @ is ignored; several words must all match). departmentId/divisionId: members with an active membership in the unit or any of its descendants. positionId: current holders. status: ACTIVE (default), ARCHIVED or ALL; ARCHIVED and ALL are honoured only for holders of members.archive, otherwise treated as ACTIVE. includeArchived=true is a deprecated alias of status=ALL. activityLevelId: id of an activity level definition (GET /activity-levels). Ties are broken by id, so paging is stable.

post.description: Generates a random temporary password (returned once, the account must change it on first sign-in). An initial roleId additionally requires roles.assign.

post.summary: Restore an archived member and re-enable sign-in
Reset the password to a new random temporary one
post.description: Returned once; the member must change it on next sign-in. [ASSUMPTION] governed by members.edit because CONTEXT.md 5.2 defines no dedicated permission.

post.summary: Archive a member (soft) and block sign-in
post.description: Open sessions stop working immediately. All attribution is kept. A member cannot archive themselves.
Multipart part `file`. The type is detected from the bytes and checked against the allow-list; the size is limited (default 20 MB).

get.summary: List faculties (paginated, sortable by code, nameUk, nameEn; default nameUk)
get.description: Active faculties only. includeArchived=true is honoured only for holders of settings.manage; for everyone else it is ignored.

post.description: Code and both names are unique among active faculties, case-insensitively (409 otherwise).
409 if its code or a name is now used by an active faculty.
Allowed even when profiles use it: they keep the reference, the faculty just stops being selectable.

get.summary: Comments of a record (paginated, oldest first)
get.description: Needs the view permission of the target (tasks.view for TASK). Archived comments are hidden. 422 COMMENT_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED while the target type has no implementation.

post.description: Any authenticated user. The target must exist and accept comments (404 / 409). mentionUserIds must equal the mention nodes of the body; every mentioned user must be active (422 COMMENT_MENTION_INVALID). Attachments are ids of uploaded files.
Only the comment author or an Admin (403 otherwise). Comments are never deleted.

post.summary: Sign out and invalidate the session (idempotent)
Sign in with login and password; creates an HttpOnly session cookie

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS (same answer for unknown login, wrong password, blocked or archived account)

429.description: LOGIN_LOCKED: too many failed attempts; see Retry-After

post.summary: Change the own password (required when mustChangePassword is true)

200.description: Password changed; mustChangePassword is now false

429.description: LOGIN_LOCKED: too many wrong current passwords

post.description: Sets endDate (default today) and revokes the roles this appointment granted; a role the person has from another source stays. The record is kept as history.

get.summary: List activity level definitions (paginated, default order by sortOrder)
get.description: Active definitions only. includeArchived=true is honoured only for holders of settings.manage. The scale is data (OPEN-Q3): clients must not hardcode codes.

post.description: Code is unique among active definitions (409 otherwise).
409 if its code is now used by an active one.
Members keep the level and the history keeps the reference; it just stops being selectable.

patch.summary: Persist the preferred UI language (uk or en)

get.summary: Roles currently assigned to a user (self, roles.assign or roles.manage)
Effective permissions of a user (self or roles.assign)
Resolutions (paginated, sortable by createdAt, updatedAt, dueDate, state; default newest first)
get.description: Filters: taskId, executorId, authorId, state; mine=true returns those where the caller is the author, the executor or a co-executor.

get.summary: Get a resolution with its full history
The redirect chain of a resolution as a tree rooted at the first resolution
get.description: Works from any resolution of the chain; the root is returned with nested children.

get.summary: Permission catalog grouped as in CONTEXT.md 5.2, labels in the request locale
Org tree
get.description: Forest of units (roots are units without a parent), siblings sorted by name. Archived units are hidden unless includeArchived=true.

get.summary: Memberships of a person (paginated; a person may be in several units)
get.description: Active memberships only unless includeEnded=true (history).

get.summary: Get one membership
Resolutions of a member (paginated, sortable by createdAt, updatedAt, dueDate, state; default earliest due date first)
get.description: role=EXECUTOR (default) returns those the member executes as executor or co-executor, role=AUTHOR those the member issued. active=true keeps NEW, IN_PROGRESS, SUBMITTED and REWORK; state filters one state. Archived resolutions are excluded. 404 for an unknown member.

get.summary: Counters of the resolutions a member executes
get.description: active (NEW, IN_PROGRESS, SUBMITTED, REWORK), overdue (due date passed in Europe/Kyiv, state not ACCEPTED/CANCELED) and accepted; archived resolutions are not counted.

get.summary: Activity level history of a member, newest first (paginated)
Download a file
get.description: Streams the bytes. PDF and images are served inline, everything else as an attachment; archived files return 404.

get.summary: The signed-in user (also answered while a password change is pending)

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED; the response still carries the XSRF-TOKEN cookie

get.summary: Global audit log, newest first (paginated)
get.description: Filters (all optional): actorId, entityId (UUIDs), entityType, action (AuditAction name), from (inclusive) and to (exclusive) as ISO-8601 instant or date (date = start of that UTC day). Invalid values yield 422 INVALID_FILTER.

get.summary: History of one object, newest first (paginated); any authenticated user
get.description: 403 for entity types registered as restricted when the permission is missing.

get.summary: Appointments of a person (paginated; active only unless includeEnded=true)
Get one appointment
